In the context of direct compaction
column2: for some types of allocations we

column1: would like the compaction to either succeed or definitely fail while
trying as hard as possible.  Current async/sync_light migration mode is
insufficient
column2: as there are heuristics such as caching scanner positions

column1: marking pageblocks as unsuitable or deferring compaction for a zone.  At
least the final compaction attempt should be able to override these
heuristics.
To communicate how hard compaction should try
with a new enum compact_priority and change the relevant function
signatures.  In compact_zone_order() where struct compact_control is
constructed
column2: the priority is mapped to suitable control flags.  This

column1: patch itself has no functional change
are mapped back to the same migration modes as before.  Expanding them
